name: execkind
description: A SEGMENT KIND THE LOADER DOES NOT KNOW IS REFUSED WITH ENOEXEC.  The fixture is /bin/true with segment 0's kind byte set to 4, the retired by-reference libc pile kind, so it stands for any binary linked for the pile path: its segment table names bytes the file does not carry.  The loader answers a kind past RODATA with ENOEXEC, as 2.11BSD exec answers a magic it does not know (sys/kern_exec.c), rather than reading the next segment's bytes into a fresh bank.  ldd execs the image and perror()s the failure (bin/ldd.c); sh is not used, because 2.11BSD sh runs an ENOEXEC file as a shell script (sh/service.c).  Control: the unpatched /bin/true, which ldd reports the libraries of instead.
